messages.subject: simple question about fortran code
parts:
Hi all,

I am not by any means an expert in Fortran programing, so this might be a silly question, but why are some logical expressions evaluated twice in many part of the code. For instance (lines 3140-3141 in ECTOTHERM.f):

IF((CLIMB.EQ.'N').OR.(CLIMB.EQ.'N'))THEN
         IF((BURROW.EQ.'N').OR.(BURROW.EQ.'N'))THEN

Thank you so much for your time!

Best,
Urtzi

messages.author: e46cb5dd353b7dfb
messages.subject: Re: simple question about fortran code
parts:
Hi Urtzi,

That's just a hangover from waaaay back (before I was born) where Warren had it set up with interactive user input at the console and the user might have put lower or upper case. But recently I converted all the code to upper case. I should delete it and save a few nanoseconds!!

All the best,
Mike
